	scaling_modifiers_while_active = { modifier = nesnd_power_appr_up_all value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = nesnd_power_appr_all } add = var:nesnd_power_appr_all } min = 0 } }
	scaling_modifiers_while_active = { modifier = nesnd_power_appr_down_all value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = nesnd_power_appr_all } add = var:nesnd_power_appr_all } multiply = -1 min = 0 } }

	scripted_progress_bar = nesnd_cabinet_power_bar
	scripted_progress_bar = nesnd_cabinet_balance_bar
	scripted_progress_bar = nesnd_cabinet_intrigue_bar

	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_law
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_reward
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_placate
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_mobilize
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_restrain
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_calm
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_investigate
	scripted_button = nesnd_cabinet_btn_share

	on_weekly_pulse = { effect = { nesnd_power_refresh = { REGIME = cabinet } } }
	on_monthly_pulse = { effect = { nesnd_power_month = { REGIME = cabinet } } }

	status_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:nesnd_power_case ?= 2 } desc = nesnd_cabinet_status_b }
			desc = nesnd_cabinet_status_a
		}
	}
}
